en: Colorized historic postcard view of a grand neoclassical building with a large dome topped by a winged statue, identified as part of an art academy. In the foreground are curved stone stairways and a formal flower garden with geometric beds. In the background rises a large domed church and surrounding city buildings. The scene is tranquil with a single figure walking down the stairs. The printed caption at the top is in German.
